datasets.label: cyclic_3d (point cloud, 3D)
datasets.text: Six peaks in a ring; the answer is a 6-cycle.

variants.label: Ours
variants.summary: Our pipeline: steepest ascent, the highest pass between touching basins, then persistence simplification.

traits.neighbourhood: kNN graph, k = 20
traits.ties: broken by vertex index (a strict total order)
traits.saddles: the highest pass between every two basins that touch
traits.links: each saddle joins exactly two maxima
traits.loops: a loop-closing saddle is kept only if the valley below it runs deep (relief >= 0.5)
traits.simplification: persistence: the noise slider (p_lo) merges small peaks, p_hi cuts deep links

variants.label: AnyEG
variants.summary: AnyEG (BuptCIAGroup): steepest ascent on the GPU, true saddles by an upper-link test, arcs to every neighbouring basin; no simplification.

traits.neighbourhood: the same kNN graph as ours, k = 20 (AnyEG itself takes meshes only)
traits.ties: AnyEG breaks none; here values are replaced by their (value, index) rank first
traits.saddles: vertices whose higher neighbours fall into two or more separate groups (true saddles)
traits.links: a saddle gets an arc to every basin among its neighbours, also through lower neighbours, so it can join three or more maxima
traits.loops: no filter: every saddle is kept
traits.simplification: none: every maximum and saddle is shown, the slider does not apply
